visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman in a pink and white ski suit stands on a glass-walled observation deck overlooking a snow-covered mountain range. She holds a snowboard and waves to the camera. The lighting is bright natural daylight. (2) The scene shifts to the woman snowboarding down a slope, viewed from a low-angle handheld perspective. She eventually falls onto the snow. (3) A young man in a blue ski jacket and goggles points at a large trail map board labeled 'MONA YONG PYONG' in a snowy outdoor setting. (4) Inside a resort building, the woman interacts with a staff member at a reception desk. The background is a brightly lit hotel lobby. (5) A montage follows showing various resort facilities: yellow and orange cable cars ascending a mountain, a large cafeteria with numerous tables, and close-ups of food menus featuring noodles and chicken. (6) A screen recording of a mobile phone shows a website for 'MONA YONGPYONG' with menu options for accommodation and ski packages being selected. (7) A high-angle shot captures the expansive ski slopes with several skiers and lifts active under a clear blue sky. (8) The video concludes with a sunset view over the mountains followed by a selfie-style shot of the couple on a ski lift.
